data.name: Hamnaah
data.gender_notes: Hamnaah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A gentle and lovely name derived from the Arabic root 'h-m-n'. It is mentioned in the Hadith as the name of a female companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Hamnaah carries the meaning “Gentle, lovely” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hamnaah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, lovely and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name with gentle and loving essence.
data.etymology: Hamnaah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, lovely.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamnaah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: حمنة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم بنت النبي، حمنة بنت جحش، أسلمت و هاجرت مع النبي
in_arabic.long_meaning: حمنة بنت جحش العبدريّة، كانت متزوجةً من أبي سعيد الخدريّ رضي الله عنهما، و أسلمت و هاجرت مع النبيّ صلى الله عليه و سلم، و هي من السابقين إلى الإسلام، و تعتبر من أمهات المؤمنين

in_urdu.name: حمنہ
in_urdu.meaning: نبی کریم کی بیوی، حمنہ بنت جحش، اسلام قبول کیا اور نبی کے ساتھ ہجرت کی
in_urdu.long_meaning: حمنہ بنت جحش عبدریہ، نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ وسلم کی بیوی ابو سعید خدری رضی اللہ عنہ کی زوجہ تھیں، اسلام قبول کیا اور نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ وسلم کے ساتھ ہجرت کی، ان کی شمولیت ابتدائی اسلام میں ہوئی

in_english.name: Hamnaah
in_english.meaning: Companion of Prophet Muhammad, Hamnah bint Jahsh, early adopter of Islam
in_english.long_meaning: Hamnah bint Jahsh was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad and the wife of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri. She accepted Islam and migrated with the Prophet, being one of the early converts to Islam. Her name is derived from the Arabic root 'h-m-n' which means 'to be warm' or 'to be protected'.

data.cultural_impact: Hamnaah is a name deeply rooted in Islamic culture, particularly in the Middle East and North Africa where Arabic languages are spoken. The name carries an elegant and charming sound, reminiscent of the rich and expressive language of the Quran. Hamnaah also connects us to the Prophet's companions, a living link to the early history of Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: Hamnaah holds special spiritual significance for Muslims as it is mentioned in the Hadith, the sayings and actions of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). Through this connection, the name symbolizes closeness to the Prophet and infuses a sense of spiritual grounding. The name also evokes the Prophet's companions, their dedication and faith, and reminds us of the spiritual strength we can draw from their lives.
